results.title: Allah is Not Obliged
results.overview: When ten-year-old Birahima’s mother dies, he leaves his native village in Guinea, accompanied by the sorcerer and cook Yacouba, to search for his aunt Mahan. Crossing the border into Liberia, they are seized by rebels and forced into military service. Birahima becomes a child-soldier. Fighting in a chaotic civil war alongside many other boys, Birahima sees death, torture, dismemberment and madness but somehow manages to retain his own sanity.

results.title: Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity: Jo-Chaku Course
results.original_title: 超宇宙刑事ギャバン インフィニティ 蒸着講座
results.overview: Use the Gavarion Trigger to Jo-Chaku! You too can master "Jo-Chaku"! Be sure to check out Gavan Infinity's battle too!

results.title: Vittorio De Sica: Staging Life
results.original_title: Vittorio De Sica - La vita in scena
results.overview: A documentary feature film about Vittorio De Sica, one of the greatest masters of world cinema. Through a new access to his family, rare archives and testimonies of contemporary artists and filmmakers from the entire world, the ilm retraces his life, his work and legacy. An intimate portrait of an author able to transform the observation of the real in an universal emotion and reveals the modernity of a gaze which keeps on illuminating cinema and our way of seeing the world.

results.title: Cinta Lama Babak Kedua #CLBK
results.overview: Ambar and Raka have planned their wedding and dreamed of a happy future together, just like any other couple. But their plans are put to the test when Akung Abi and Nin Sita — their grandfather and grandmother — turn out to be former lovers who parted ways 56 years ago. Since their youth, the relationship between Abi and Sita has been shaped by a past filled with stories that were never truly resolved. Without realizing it, that unfinished history begins to affect Ambar and Raka’s relationship in the present. The deeper they uncover their grandparents’ past, the more they feel that something has remained unsettled for the last 56 years.

results.title: Albatross
results.overview: Maria, burdened with caregiving for her sick husband, gets invited to a party.

results.title: FELICITINA: just one dose
results.overview: Based in the 70s, a family is watching TV before bedtime when a commercial comes on claiming that their product can change their life for good.

results.title: Keizo Murase: The Last Monster Maker
results.original_title: Keizo Murase: The Last Monster Maker
results.overview: Artist. Innovator. Teacher. Inspiration.  From his humble beginnings as a modeling assistant in 1958 to his acclaimed directorial debut, Brush of the God in 2024, the legendary Keizo Murase spent his career dedicated to the art of monster making, bringing life to many of Japan’s most iconic and beloved kaiju characters. But behind every rampaging monster and transforming superhero were the hands of a dedicated artist, whose contributions to the Japanese film industry might have been forgotten, if not for a dedicated group of close friends, longtime admirers, and fans from every corner of the globe. For the first time in the English-speaking world, the life and career of this singular creative visionary is revealed and celebrated in a feature-length tribute that sheds detailed light on the accomplishments of Japan’s last great monster maker, and preserves the stories of those who knew and loved him best.

results.title: Mike Epps: Delusional
results.overview: Follows comedian Mike Epps as he discusses how a little delusion and a lot of hustle made him a star.

results.title: Splish Splash Forever!
results.overview: 11-year-old Pola and her best friend Polly spend all their time at the local outdoor pool, Plitsch Platsch, where Polly's parents run a café. When the pool is closed due to budget cuts and Polly's family moves away, Pola suddenly finds herself alone. Refusing to give up, she teams up with her clever new classmate Rosalie to try to save the pool. Together, they start a petition and rally with the local children. Along the way, Pola discovers new friendships and learns that change is a part of growing up.

results.title: Remembering Wes Craven: His Life, Legacy and Nightmares
results.original_title: Remembering Wes Craven: His Life, Legacy and Nightmares
results.overview: Feature-length portrait piece on the career of Wes Craven, including contributions from his closest collaborators.

results.title: The Extraordinary Life of Vera Valdez
results.original_title: A Extraordinária Vida de Vera Valdez
results.overview: A portrait of Brazilian actress Vera Valdez, tracing her years as a model for Dior and, most notably, Coco Chanel; her flirtation with the French New Wave; her complex journey through motherhood; and her imprisonment and torture during Brazil’s military dictatorship.

results.title: Soy Luna: Recap Seasons 1, 2 and 3
results.overview: Soy Luna tells the story of Luna Valente, a teenage girl who lives and dreams on roller skates. Over the course of three seasons, Luna and her friends embark on adventures, fall in love, sing and dance, and, above all, glide across the legendary Jam & Roller skating rink. Before the wheels start turning again… relive the best moments!

results.title: Inhumation
results.overview: After being pronounced dead prematurely, a man afflicted with a rare condition is determined to put his fears to rest - no matter the cost.

results.title: Chicken Scratch
results.overview: A gambling addict on the eve of eviction in NYC must embark on a wealthy stranger's quest to retrieve a plate of legendary chicken wings in exchange for his rent money.

results.title: Going for Two
results.overview: In the fall of 1983, as their beloved college football team vies for the National Championship, a fatherless 12-year-old boy and his tomboy neighbor embark on a quest for his 'manhood'.

results.title: Doggy Style
results.overview: Amid an epidemic that turns people into dogs, a man slowly succumbing to the disease searches for a missing girlfriend, believing she is his last tether to humanity.

results.title: How Hard Can It Be?
results.overview: Mallory, an ambitious New York reporter, is assigned to a story on the Best Small Town in America, sending her to Alabama. Mallory stays at a BnB run by Robin and her charming son Wren, a former Marine. Beneath her exterior, Mallory’s warm side is revealed as she bonds with the community, especially Wren. Zeke, Mallory’s best friend and Hollywood heartthrob, visits her there and challenges her to rethink what she really wants.

results.title: Yours, Always
results.overview: A bright college student begins receiving anonymous handwritten letters, drawing her into a quiet yet unsettling mystery. As an unseen presence lingers, strange events unfold, and the true meaning behind the messages slowly comes to light.
